scope: 43 raster sources in native/windowed and prepared storage, SDR plus linear HDR Metal attachment equality across RAM/spill/cancellation/pressure/swap
hdr_comparison: Exact binary16 values at all 64x64 RGBA components before/after swap

independent_oracle.checks: above-one and signed values, exposure, opaque alpha and padding removal

gpu_credit: Each completed HDR submission releases renderer credit to zero
limitations: 43 fixture sources, not all 100 formats or all variants
Before/after equality is transport qualification, not independent color/decoder correctness
Independent constant oracle covers signed/HDR/exposure/opaque output, not every source color conversion
Scientific values use explicit display window; RLA uses explicit alpha/color interpretation
64x64 offscreen Rgba16Float is not physical HDR display/color/luminance qualification
Local-disk managed pressure is not physical slow storage or OS-wide pressure
